title: An operator can rescope a sprint's goal, and close --summary maps clauses to the sprint's own items
goal: A sprint's goal changes only by the operator (set SP --goal G --by operator, refused without it), so a rescope that a gate answers lands in the goal close --summary reads, not only in notes; and close --summary names an open item outside the sprint beside an unmet clause only as gate g2's answer says, never as its carrier, so a one-word clause such as 'passing' is no longer matched to another sprint's item (SP-eahtellz: 'passing' was shown as carried by ST-e5u5zhrc of SP-matmvkn6). goal_clause_lines already credits a clause only to a done item of the sprint itself; the fallback 'unmet, carried by <open item elsewhere>' (bl_land.py, a 50% word match) is what changes.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,os,json,shutil;t=tempfile.mkdtemp();s.run(['git','init','-q',t],check=True);os.makedirs(t+'/kb/_self/backlog');b=[sys.executable,os.getcwd()+'/_tools/backlog.py','--root',t];run=lambda *a:s.run(b+list(a),capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=t);sp=run('new','sprint','--title','S','--goal','old goal clause').stdout.split()[2];goal=lambda:json.load(open(f'{t}/kb/_self/backlog/{sp}.json',encoding='utf-8-sig')).get('goal');a=run('set',sp,'--goal','rescoped goal clause');ga=goal();b2=run('set',sp,'--goal','rescoped goal clause','--by','operator');gb=goal();shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True);print('no --by: exit',a.returncode,'goal',repr(ga),'| --by operator: exit',b2.returncode,'goal',repr(gb),(b2.stderr or b2.stdout).strip()[:100]);sys.exit(0 if a.returncode!=0 and ga=='old goal clause' and b2.returncode==0 and gb=='rescoped goal clause' else 1)

import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land;it={'SP-a':{'kind':'sprint','goal':'the alpha reader works; passing'},'ST-1':{'kind':'story','status':'done','title':'Alpha reader','goal':'the alpha reader works'},'ST-2':{'kind':'story','status':'todo','title':'Checks passing','goal':'make passing stable'}};bl=types.SimpleNamespace(items=it,label=lambda i:i);out=bl_land.goal_clause_lines(bl,'SP-a',['ST-1']);print(out);sys.exit(0 if 'ST-1' in ' '.join(out) and 'ST-2' not in ' '.join(out) else 1)

gates.question: When set changes a planned sprint's goal after its start gate was approved, does the approval stand?
options: the start gate is reopened for a new answer
set refuses a goal change on an approved sprint

gates.question: How does close --summary name an open item outside the sprint whose words match an unmet clause?
options: only with two or more shared words, labelled similar open item outside the sprint
gates.recommendation: only with two or more shared words, labelled similar open item outside the sprint
gates.answer: only with two or more shared words, labelled similar open item outside the sprint

notes: Premise (by code read 2026-10-07): bl_items.py refuses any sprint field but notes, links and delegates, so clause 1 reproduces; goal_clause_lines credits only the sprint's own done items, and its unmet fallback matches an open item elsewhere on half its words. Its check names the live SP-ktup3cha and breaks once that sprint closes: before the claim, replace it with a planted --root repo (new sprint, set --goal with and without --by operator) and an in-process bl_land.goal_clause_lines over planted items, one assertion per clause.
